story_section.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Founded in 2026, Barbuk emerged from a simple observation: countless businesses are trapped in legacy system purgatory—spending millions maintaining outdated technology while competitors race ahead with modern, AI-powered solutions.

We've seen it all: Oracle Forms 6i systems running mission-critical operations, ASP.NET WebForms apps from 2005 handling millions in transactions, VB.NET desktop apps that can't scale beyond a single office. These systems work—barely—but they're holding businesses back.

Our founders spent a decade in enterprise software, witnessing the pain of technical debt firsthand. We knew there had to be a better way. Not rip-and-replace chaos. Not endless "digital transformation" consultants billing by the hour with no tangible results. But a pragmatic, battle-tested approach that modernizes systems without destroying what works.
That's Barbuk. We're the team you call when legacy modernization isn't optional anymore.
